graphRules.directSelection: Objects with an explicit sourceRef to changed source are directly impacted.
graphRules.semanticPropagation: For each directly impacted Claim/CQ/Relation/Invariant, qualify related SAP obligations via claimRefs/cqRefs/relationRefs/globalInvariantRefs; do not recursively traverse every relation to the whole Root.
graphRules.ownership: Impacted Element is the explicit Claim semanticOwner, CQ element or SAP obligation owner. Global owner changes require global gate review, not ownership takeover.
graphRules.downstream: Function candidate is impacted only when a listed SAP obligation dependency is impacted. Production gate stays blocked even when unrelated artifacts unaffected.
graphRules.invariantRule: Source change alone never claims SAP requalification, Product authorization or actual OS effect.
graphRules.unknownSource: Unknown source is classified UNREGISTERED_SOURCE; no automatic claims invalidated; a reviewer must adjudicate whether it is genuinely unrelated.
graphRules.elementSplit: If the Memory Element ownership changes, all its directly-owned CQ/SAP and downstream dependent Function candidates must be marked for review; unrelated Root branches need not be invalidated.
graphRules.stopRule: Stop propagation at dependency leaves; no ungrounded whole-graph invalidation or automatic promotion.

reviewFixtures.why: New OS-build-specific PrivateWorkingSetSize support or field semantics changed
Reference Set trace overhead or scenario interpretation changed
Original bounded collector metric identity or privacy schema changed
Counter identity/collection interval or process name instance behavior changed
Unrelated non-register source must not silently invalidate entire memory graph

independentReviewerObligations: For changes to any original source Blob, independently verify old/new content and source applicability.
Disagreeing source or Source Owner decision may expand impact; the machine minimum is not a semantic completeness proof.
Test a new relevant source missing all reverse edges and ensure it is reported UNKNOWN, not silently treated as qualified.
Test unrelated sources and independent non-impacted Element obligations to bound false-positive invalidation.
Review each impacted SAP before allowing DIS handoff; no repair to production Function without new admission.
